div.div:
Tests (→ design doc §10): 1 JWKS over PGA without Google token (item 4, partial) 2 valid JWT end-to-end — combined headers + custom audience (items 1, 5) 3 expired / wrong-aud / missing JWT → 401 at the edge via flow hook (item 3) 4 direct PGA bypass → 403 before the container (item 2) 5 latency /auth-echo vs /hello (item 3 / §8)
Item 6 (sidecar variant) covered separately: setup-envoy.sh / cr-auth-echo-envoy — see envoy-sidecar-{sequence,headers}.drawio. Not covered: org-policy preventive controls (item 7), edge deny-list (item 8)
